## What changes for the user?

Describe the trigger/problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include host/Android/Frida versions for device work. State unavailable platforms or remaining limits.

## Notes for reviewers

Mention compatibility changes, device cleanup/recovery implications or updated third-party resources if relevant. Omit this section if it adds nothing.

- [ ] Logs, fixtures and screenshots contain only synthetic or sanitized data.
- [ ] Changed behavior and support limits are reflected in the docs.
- [ ] Upstream copyright/license notices are preserved when applicable.
